parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The region where the private gateway is located.

parameters.name: GatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the private gateway. For more information, see [ListGateway](~~2841911~~).

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description:
The ID of the attached virtual private cloud (VPC). For more information, see [ListGatewayIntranetLinkedVpc](~~2621223~~).

- Specify a VPC ID to query only the VPC peers for that VPC.

- If you do not specify a VPC ID, all VPC peers are returned.
